thread:
mira: Heads-up: Ana's birthday is Fri (remote in Lisbon). Thinking of a tiny surprise — video montage + either a plant or a snack box shipped to her. Thoughts? :birthday:
jon: love the montage idea. can we get short 10-15s clips from folks with a quick message?
devon: i'm in. can someone drop a template? like: 'hi ana, happy birthday! thanks for...'
mira: good call. template suggestion: 'Hi Ana  Happy bday! Thanks for [one thing]. Enjoy Lisbon!' keep it under 15s and record on phone or desktop.
sam: snack box sounds great. plant might be tricky to ship internationally? any logistics notes?
people-ops-bot: Tip: For international gifts, people-ops handles customs forms if you route through our vendor account. DM me to start the form.
jon: ok snack box then? non-perishable, allergy-safe. also i can stitch clips into a 1-min montage if folks upload by Thu 9am PT.
devon: can we also do a virtual 10-min coffee chat at a time that's not too late for Lisbon? 11:00 CET maybe?
mira: 11:00 CET / 05:00 PT might be rough for some US folks. what about 15:00 CET / 11:00 PT?
sam: 15:00 CET works for me. mark me down.
jon: i'll post a small Loom/guideline and an upload link. also can someone volunteer to collect funds for the snack box? we can use the team petty fund.
mira: i'll handle funds. please send payment emoji :moneybag: in reply so i know who's contributing (suggested €15 each).
devon: :moneybag: count me in.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: add this to the people-ops calendar so remote folks get the link.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Ana - Virtual Coffee + Montage" Fri 15:00 CET (invites sent)
jon: quick note on montage: please keep background noise low and say your name quickly at start so Ana knows who's speaking. no pressure for perfect takes.
mira: aaand GIF idea: let's all react during the call with :tada: so it's lively.
sam: short poll for the gift: react with :leafy_green: for plant (vendor ships), :cookie: for snack box, :gift: for digital bookstore voucher
jon: voted :cookie:
devon: :gift: (thinking books)
mira: final call at 2pm Thu. Uploads to the Loom link or DM me if you need help recording.
jon: messages for the card? drop one-liners here and i'll compile into pretty pdf card.
devon: "Happy bday Ana! Your debugging skills saved my week :)"
sam: "Hope you take a day to explore Lisbon and eat pastry after work!"
mira: "Huge thanks for all the focus & kindness you bring. Enjoy your day!"
jon: thanks all. plan: montage + virtual coffee Fri 15:00 CET, snack box vs voucher poll ongoing, funds handled by mira, uploads to Loom by Thu 9am PT. i'll post the montage once stitched. :sparkles:
